item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 28/Mar/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream now affecting the coast of Guangdong will be gradually replaced by a southerly airstream today and tomorrow. It will be hot with one or two showers over the region. Under the influence of upper-air disturbances, there will be heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over southern China over the weekend and early next week. With the upper-air disturbances departing slightly, the weather will improve over the coastal areas of Guangdong midweek next week.
